beats.action: finger taps wrist
beats.line: Tapping your wrist rewinds any mistake by ten seconds.

beats.action: kid's hands wrinkle as dropped phone flies back up
beats.line: But your hands age one year every time.

beats.action: Jace retakes selfie, turns body to pose
beats.line: Jace rewinds bad selfies

beats.action: Jace's 30-yr hands vs hero's smooth hands
beats.line: Mine are fifteen. Zero taps.

beats.action: grandma's shaking hand slips from little hero's
beats.line: her hands shook too hard to hold mine.

beats.action: teen hero clenches fist
beats.line: So I saved mine.

beats.action: golden-hour lab, Mia seated next to Jace
beats.line: Then chemistry. Mia sits beside Jace.

beats.action: Mia slides hero a pencil
beats.line: She once lent me a pencil

beats.action: Jace swagger at bench
beats.line: Jace was showing off.

beats.action: two identical bottles: red label acid, plain water on its left
beats.line: Two bottles. Red label is acid.

beats.action: Jace grabs red one, Mia leans close
beats.line: He grabbed the red one. Mia leaned in.

beats.action: pour, hiss, beaker bursts toward Mia
beats.line: It burst, right at her face.

beats.action: TAP 1, rewind to Jace reaching for bottle
beats.line: Ten seconds back, before the pour.

beats.action: hero yells, Jace pours anyway
beats.line: I yelled. He poured anyway.

beats.action: TAP 2
beats.line: Tap.

beats.action: hero grabs arm, gets shoved, Jace pours
beats.line: He shoved me, and poured.

beats.action: TAP 3, knuckles wrinkle (aged_hands_3)
beats.line: My knuckles started to wrinkle.

beats.action: hero steps back, eyes narrow
beats.line: I stopped fighting and started watching.

beats.action: water bottle highlighted left of acid
beats.line: Water, left of the acid.

beats.action: Jace's right hand highlighted on pour
beats.line: He pours with his right hand.

beats.action: Jace turns away to pose, on-screen 7s mark
beats.line: At second seven, he turns to pose.

beats.action: TAP 4 (aged_hands_4)
beats.line: Tap. Last loop.

beats.action: hero waits, Jace turns his back
beats.line: I waited. He turned.

beats.action: phone flash; hero swaps bottle positions
beats.line: Flash. I swapped the bottles.

beats.action: clear water pours, nothing happens
beats.line: He poured water. Nothing happened.

beats.action: Jace laughs, hero tugs sleeves over hands
beats.line: Called me boring. Sleeves over my hands.

beats.action: Jace spots hero's aged hands
beats.line: "Dude, you're nineteen?"

beats.action: four-tap montage flash over hands
beats.line: Four taps. Four years. For ten seconds.

beats.action: Mia's unhurt face fills frame, she smiles and slides a pencil
beats.line: Mia smiled at me, her face perfect, and lent me a pencil again.

beats.action: grandma's trembling old hands
beats.line: Grandma spent her years on her own mistakes.

beats.action: hero's aged hands hold Mia's pencil, steady
beats.line: I spent mine on someone else.

beats.action: hero smiles beside Mia, hand rests on wrist, no tap; fade
beats.line: A few years of my hands for her whole face. They were saved for her.
